note: Hand-computed from the rules in docs/superpowers/specs/day-analogs-rebuild-2026-10-02.md (P1a). Never regenerate from either builder's output. P2's Python backfill must pass every case.
format: A bar is [ts, open, high, low, close, volume, contract]: ts is a UTC ISO minute stamp, the four prices are NUMERIC text exactly as the Neon driver returns them (so "NaN" can appear; convert with Number() or float()), volume is a number, contract is a string or null. A bars list is the whole ts-sorted series the builder reads: lead-in bars before 08:30 CT and the bar after the window or session may be present, and the function picks its own bars by the minute relative to the 08:30 CT anchor (window: 0..nMinutes-1; labels: 0..cashSessionMinutes-1, 390 or 210 on a half day). windows: {name, date, nMinutes, bars, expect}. expect is {ok: true, window: {features, summary, open, close, high, low, volume, bars, contract}} or {ok: false, reason}. Compare features within 1e-12 each (length nMinutes) and every other field exactly. labels: {name, date, bars, expect} with expect {ok: true, labels: {open, high, low, close, rangePt, upExc, downExc}} or {ok: false, reason}. summaries: {name, window: {nMinutes, open, close, high, low, volume}, expect}: format the summary line of that window and compare the string exactly. Refusal reasons are checked in this order and the first failure wins: not_trading_day, no_anchor, too_few_bars, bad_bar, mixed_contract, flagged. A case that holds two failures is there to pin that order. The core never returns incomplete.

windows.name: N=15 CST: carry-forward over a missing minute; lead-in and the 08:45 bar ignored
N=15 CDT (2026-03-09): the anchor is 13:30Z
anchor 08:30 opens 50 pt from the 08:29 close
the bar after the window opens 20 pt from the last close
the bar after the window opens exactly 15 pt away: no gap
a gap is measured against the neighbouring bar when 08:40 is missing
a real spike and revert with no open gap is kept
a NaN close is bad_bar, not flagged, even with a 16 pt gap
a NaN close on the 08:29 bar before the anchor is bad_bar
a NaN open on the bar after the window is bad_bar
a zero low price is bad_bar
a negative volume is bad_bar
ESZ6 with ESZ26 and a NULL is one contract, ESZ6
ESZ6 with ESH7 is mixed_contract
9 bars is too_few_bars
10 bars (MIN_BARS) is ok; the last close is carried to minute 14
no 08:30 bar (the series starts 08:31) is no_anchor
2026-11-26 (Thanksgiving) is not_trading_day
9 bars with a 16 pt gap is too_few_bars (check 3 before 6)
2026-11-26 with no 08:30 bar is not_trading_day (check 1 before 2)
9 bars with a NaN close is too_few_bars (check 3 before 4)
a NaN close with ESZ6 and ESH7 is bad_bar (check 4 before 5)
ESZ6 and ESH7 with a 16 pt gap is mixed_contract (check 5 before 6)
an open 16 pt below the previous close is a gap: direction does not matter
a zero volume is allowed
N=60 ramp: every bar present
N=30 ramp: minutes 10 and 11 missing carry the minute-9 close

labels.name: full day: 390 bars plus the 15:00 bar
389 bars plus the 15:00 bar is too_few_bars
a 20 pt gap on the 15:00 bar is flagged
half day 2026-11-27: 210 bars plus the 12:00 bar
half day: a NaN high is bad_bar
half day: ESZ6 with ESH7 is mixed_contract
half day: a 16 pt gap on the 11:00 bar is flagged

summaries.name: 412,250 is an exact tie and rounds up to 412.3K
3,125,000 is an exact tie and rounds up to 3.13M
1,150 is 1.15 as a double, just below the tie: rounds down to 1.1K
900,050 is 900.05 as a double, just below the tie: rounds down to 900.0K
1,005,000 is 1.005 as a double, just below the tie: rounds down to 1.00M
999,999 rounds up to 1000.0K: the formatter keeps K below 1,000,000
a negative delta keeps its sign
